root_cause.text: Incomplete reservation of hypervisor-owned memory in the EFI memory map (firmware bug) causes the kernel’s page allocator to treat a portion of the Gunyah hypervisor metadata region as conventional memory, leading to fatal synchronous external aborts when the kernel accesses those addresses.
root_cause.evidence: "However, the EFI memory map provided by firmware only reserves the subrange 0x91a40000–0x91a87fff (288 KiB). The remaining portion (0x91a88000–0x91afffff) is incorrectly reported as conventional memory." and "As a result, the allocator may hand out PFNs inside the hypervisor owned region, causing fatal aborts."
